articles.title: Saudi-led forces strike Yemen port as Houthis warn airlines off the kingdom
articles.description: By Yasmine Ghania and Muhammad Al GebalyNov 20 (Reuters) - The Saudi-led coalition fighting Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said it had struck the Red Sea port of Hodeidah to destroy Houthi capabilities on Friday, as the militants warned airlines to avoid Saudi airspace, pledging new air strikes within hours. The developments, a day after the group struck the tallest skyscraper in Riyadh, signalled a worsening of a conflict that has brought a humanitarian crisis to Yemen and severe disruption to Saudi Arabia, in parallel with the US-led war against Iran.

articles.title: Two men to stand trial in UK next year over RAF Fairford incident allegedly linked to Iran
articles.description: LONDON, Nov 20 (Reuters) - Two men charged over September's security incident at the RAF Fairford military base, which British and US prosecutors say was orchestrated on behalf of Iran, will stand trial in London in November next year, a judge said on Friday.RAF Fairford had been used by the US to carry out strikes on Iran, but B-1 bomberswere withdrawn on security grounds shortly after five British men were arrested outside the base in southwest England in the early hours of September 27.
